nl.title: Hoe werkt de checkout en welke betaalmethoden zijn er?
nl.excerpt: Hoe werkt de checkout en welke betaalmethoden zijn er: concrete handleiding van TripleZero iT met voorbereiding, stappen en controles.
nl.bodyHtml:
De checkout van TripleZero iT loopt via Stripe Checkout (eenmalige betaling). Je ziet een specificatie met bedragen excl. btw, btw en totaal incl. btw.

Tip: Gebruik het e-mailadres waarmee je ook je klantaccount wilt koppelen, zodat facturen en berichten kloppen.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of e-mail. Vermeld altijd je domeinnaam en een duidelijke omschrijving van het probleem, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Bekijk ook andere artikelen in de kennisbank voor aanvullende uitleg over hosting, e-mail en beveiliging.

en.title: How does the checkout work and what payment methods are available?
en.excerpt: How does the checkout work and what payment methods are available: steps in the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin for checkout, work, payment.
en.bodyHtml:
For How does the checkout work and what payment methods are available follow a targeted checklist in the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin. Core themes: checkout, work, payment.

Preparation

  • Access to the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin
  • Focus of this article: checkout, work, payment
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Work in the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin. Stay on the topic checkout, work, payment — no parallel experiments.
  2. Put the plugin/app in test mode with test keys for checkout first.
  3. Configure webhook URL + secret; validate signatures.
  4. Run a test payment that hits work; check order status.
  5. Go live only after success; repeat a small smoke test.
  6. Document what you changed around checkout, work, payment (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for checkout, work, payment matches “How does the checkout work and what payment methods are available”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside checkout work payment
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get checkout, work, payment right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if checkout, work, payment touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: the payment dashboard (Mollie/Stripe) + shop admin, backups, tickets.
